stem: Priya is at home in Chennai during the monsoon. In which situation is it unsafe for her to handle an electrical fitting?

options.text: Turning off a dry switch with dry hands
Touching a light switch with wet hands
Unplugging a phone charger by holding its plug
Asking an adult to replace a fused bulb

teacher.key_rationale: Wet hands lower body resistance, so touching a switch with wet hands can let current pass through the body and cause injury; the other three options describe safe practices. Key recalculated as B for the retargeted unsafe-handling decision.
